scenes.narration: Somewhere on your card statement right now, there's a charge you forgot you agreed to.
scenes.visual: A credit card is drawn, then a small looping recurring-charge icon appears next to it

scenes.narration: A calendar appears, and a clock, ticking past the date you meant to cancel.
scenes.visual: A calendar and a clock are drawn side by side

scenes.narration: Zoom out, and you can see the whole system was built around you never getting here.
scenes.visual: Camera pulls back to reveal the full scene: card, recurring icon, calendar, clock, and a brain thinking it over
